examples.description: See every template and its slots.

description: Free. The media templates: product-shot (product shot), product-lifestyle (product in a real place), poster (promo poster), showcase-video (product video), explainer-voice (voice-over with captions), brand-mockup (brand mockups). Each entry says what it makes, what it delivers, its price, the models it runs on, an example_url of a real output, and its slots: the inputs template.run takes (name, kind, required, choices, default). Image slots take what image.variation takes: an image library asset_key, a public https URL or a data:image URL. NEXT: template.run with a template id and its slots.
